SourceProxy.name: SHYXHoleFillFilter
SourceProxy.label: SHYX Hole Fill (CGAL)

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Hole Fill (CGAL): Fill holes (or a selected patch) on a surface using CGAL PMP.

SourceProxy.Documentation: Fills mesh boundary cycles with CGAL triangulate_refine_and_fair_hole. By default runs the same polygon-soup cleanup as SHYX Mesh Checker (orient_polygon_soup + repair_polygon_soup) so duplicate vertices on a hole rim become a fillable cycle; without that, filling the raw mesh is often a silent no-op. Accepts any vtkDataSet; non-PolyData inputs are converted to a surface with vtkGeometryFilter first. Optional Selection removes triangles or points first (applied before soup repair). Creating the filter copies the Input's active selection into the Selection widget. Output is the repaired surface plus new fill triangles.

InputProperty.name: Selection
InputProperty.Documentation: Optional selection: removed from the mesh before filling (same semantics as VESPA hole filling).

IntVectorProperty.name: RepairPolygonSoup
IntVectorProperty.label: Repair polygon soup first
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Default on. Same as Mesh Checker: orient_polygon_soup then repair_polygon_soup (weld duplicates, drop degenerate/duplicate faces), then polygon_soup_to_polygon_mesh, then fill every boundary cycle. Turn off to pass the raw surface to vtkCGALPatchFilling (Euler add_face); duplicate vertices around a hole then often produce no fill and no error.

IntVectorProperty.name: FairingContinuity
IntVectorProperty.label: Fairing Continuity
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Tangential continuity of the filled patch: 0 = C0 / planar-style filling, 1 = C1, 2 = C2 (CGAL fairing_continuity).
